caption: The drawing depicts a square ornament placed at the center of a cream or light beige colored sheet. The ornament consists of a symmetrical, raised design featuring a central circular element surrounded by four triangular shapes radiating from the center toward each corner, forming an "X" pattern. The triangles are interspersed with small scroll-like curves. The ornament also includes concentric circles and repeating decorative motifs within these circles. The color palette of the ornament consists of earthy shades, primarily gold, brown, and hints of reddish tones, giving the appearance of carved and gilded wood. The design is sharply defined against the plain background, with no other objects or decorations present. A fine rectangular border surrounds the main drawing, and the handwritten name "Bertha Semple" appears in the lower right corner of the sheet.
title: Carved Wood Ornament
